fnol_text: My name is Ethan Castillo and I live at 791 Thornbury Court, Riverton, WY 82573. You can reach me on (555) 833-1015 or ethan.castillo@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 14 October 2026 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2025-00129. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Castillo on (555) 833-1015 to acknowledge the claim. Ethan confirmed the loss date as 14 October 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Liam Fitzgerald gave a statement by phone.
Ethan sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
